description: Tier 2: Functional primitives. Cross-tradition, defined by yes/no conditions. Aligned with Kleiner & Tull, PyPhi, Dharmakīrti. See FORMALISATION_SCHEMA.md.

primitives.yes_no_condition: Does changing x change the distribution over y?
primitives.source_ref: Kleiner & Tull: caus, eff repertoires. Dharmakīrti: arthakriyā. IIT 4.0: cause-effect.

primitives.definition: System cannot be partitioned without information loss. φ(e) = min_{z≠1} d(e, ē(z)).
primitives.yes_no_condition: Is there a partition that preserves all cause-effect structure?
primitives.lean_hint: Integration : Substrate → Prop. Connects to Set.Partition. Kleiner & Tull Def 8.
primitives.source_ref: Kleiner & Tull Def 8. PyPhi: phi(). IIT 4.0 postulate 2.

primitives.definition: State becomes readable by all recipient modules
primitives.yes_no_condition: Can every specialist module access this state?
primitives.source_ref: Dehaene et al. GWT. Graph reachability from winner.

primitives.definition: System responds differentially to distinct inputs
primitives.yes_no_condition: Do different inputs produce different outputs?

primitives.definition: System's output is input to itself
primitives.yes_no_condition: Does the system take its own state as input?

primitives.definition: Process activates only above some value
primitives.yes_no_condition: Is there a cutoff below which nothing happens?

primitives.definition: Only one description level applies at a time
primitives.yes_no_condition: Do overlapping candidate systems exclude each other?
primitives.lean_hint: Exclusion : Substrate → Prop. Max over overlapping systems.
primitives.source_ref: Kleiner & Tull: Core, major complex. IIT 4.0: exclusion postulate.

primitives.definition: System is made of parts in specific relations
primitives.yes_no_condition: Does the system have distinguishable parts?
primitives.lean_hint: Composition : Substrate → Prop. IIT 6th postulate, mereology.
primitives.source_ref: Kleiner & Tull Def 1: Subs(S). IIT 4.0: composition postulate.

primitives.definition: State S is readable by process P
primitives.yes_no_condition: Can process P read state S?
primitives.lean_hint: Accessibility : State → Process → Prop. GWT needs this; distinct from Broadcast.

primitives.yes_no_condition: Is it a specific instance rather than a general kind?
primitives.lean_hint: Particularity : Substrate → Prop. Dharmakīrti svalakṣaṇa, IIT intrinsicality.

primitives.definition: There is a correct vs incorrect response
primitives.yes_no_condition: Does the system have a right/wrong distinction?
primitives.lean_hint: Normativity : Substrate → Prop. Nyāya pramāṇa, GWT specialist modules.

primitives.definition: The physical/material base of a process
primitives.lean_hint: Substrate : Type. IIT existence, Dharmakīrti, everything.

primitives.definition: Levels of organization with different descriptions
primitives.yes_no_condition: Are there nested levels of description?
primitives.lean_hint: Hierarchy : Substrate → Prop. IIT exclusion, predictive processing, lamrim.
